$comment: Write-guard classification for DynamoDB, shared by every binding. Operation names are the API action names (the X-Amz-Target suffix). Anything not listed is a write. See spec/data-stores.md.

partiql.rule: A read only when every statement in the request is a SELECT: after skipping whitespace, -- line comments and /* */ block comments, the first word, compared case-insensitively, is SELECT. Any other statement (INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, EXISTS checks inside a write transaction, or text that can't be parsed) makes the whole request a write.

notes.UpdateItem: Always a write, whatever its ReturnValues or condition.
notes.PutItem, DeleteItem: Always writes, including conditional writes whose condition fails.
notes.TransactWriteItems, BatchWriteItem: Always writes; a ConditionCheck-only transaction is still classified as a write.
